disputePackage.formalLetterText:
Date: October 24, 2026

To:
Billing & Patient Financial Services
St. Luke's Ambulatory Surgical Pavilion
450 Medical Center Way, Boston, MA 02115

RE: Formal Notice of Disputed Unbundled Charges & Excessive Markups
Patient Name: Michael Chang
Account Number: SURG-2026-4410
Statement Date: October 18, 2026
Disputed Amount: $2,350.00

Dear Billing Compliance Department,

Pursuant to the Fair Credit Billing Act (15 U.S.C. § 1666) and the CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), I am formally disputing unbundled laboratory test charges and excessive facility markups on the above-referenced account.

Following forensic analysis, the following charges are in direct violation of federal coding guidelines:

1. CPT 82040 (Albumin) - $120.00 & CPT 84075 (Alkaline Phosphatase) - $130.00
   Grievance: Illegal Unbundling. Both tests were performed on October 15, 2026, alongside CPT 80053 (Comprehensive Metabolic Panel). Under CMS NCCI standards, individual chemistry components may not be unbundled and billed separately when a comprehensive panel is charged.

2. CPT 71046 (Chest X-Ray) - $490.00
   Grievance: Severe facility markup exceeding 720% of the Medicare allowable median rate of $68.00.

3. CPT J7030 (Normal Saline Solution) - $420.00
   Grievance: Extreme pharmaceutical supply markup ($210.00 per 1,000ml bag) exceeding standard reasonable community pricing.

DEMANDS:
1. Reissue an amended statement zeroing out unbundled laboratory CPT codes 82040 and 84075.
2. Recalculate facility and supply charges pursuant to your hospital's Amount Generally Billed (AGB) rate under IRC § 501(r).
3. Maintain a freeze on credit reporting and collection actions pursuant to 15 U.S.C. § 1666 while this investigation remains pending.

Sincerely,

Michael Chang
Account #SURG-2026-4410
phoneNegotiationPoints: Step 1: Contact surgical pavilion billing at 1-888-555-7890.

Step 2: Reference Account #SURG-2026-4410 and notify them: 'I have had my bill audited under CMS NCCI rules. CPT 82040 and 84075 are unbundled subcomponents of CPT 80053 and must be written off immediately.'
Step 3: Point out the 7x markup on the chest X-ray and request an immediate self-pay discount or AGB adjustment.
